defaultPrompt: Use setup-astack to configure the external systems my astack skills use.
Use task-interview to clarify this task through an adaptive interview.
Use validate-claims to check the factual assertions in this material and assess their implications.
Use pick-next to choose what to work on next.
Use merge-brief before I merge this MR.
Use weekly-report to write my section of the weekly status.
Use how to explain this subsystem and its boundaries.
Use why to investigate the rationale behind this code.
Use unslop to edit this writing for plain language and remove AI patterns.
